scope: Terminology and context for original community Pokédex prose; not replacement lore copied from a wiki.

sources.use: Game-specific species numbering differs from the National Pokédex after generation two; resolve through the project's mapping.
The familiar dorsal plant is referred to as a seed; do not call every botanical bulb a light bulb.
The evolving dorsal plant is a flower bud; preserve flowering imagery.
Scythes describe the forelimb blades, not a generic body horn.
The carried leek is conventionally called 大葱 in Pokémon Chinese.
Synthesis has the established move name 光合作用; distinguish a named move from ordinary plant photosynthesis.
Tangelo Island is 澎柑岛, not a literal citrus substitution.
Tagtree Thicket has the established name 印记树林.
Oblivia is the side-series region 奥卜利比亚.
Aria/Pirouette forms use 歌声形态/舞步形态 rather than dictionary translations of music terminology.
Spirit World/Ghost World is 灵界; distinguish it from a mental world, and distinguish a spirit from morale or willpower.
Strib Berry uses the established encyclopedia name 青豌果; the encyclopedia marks this Chinese name as unofficial, so do not claim an official localization.
Rifure Village -> 清爽村. Encyclopedia explicitly labels this Chinese name as provisional.
Greenstation Town -> 新芽镇. Chinese name is explicitly listed.
Potpourri Island -> 香草岛. Named animated-series island.
Frond Island -> 椰子岛. Chinese names explicitly listed; distinguish from Yuzuriha/Frond-like tree names.
Mt. Shady -> 荫凉山. Navigation list uses this Chinese label; English article confirms the mountain/cavern setting.
Chocovine Town -> 木通镇. Names section confirms the Chinese name and chocolate-vine etymology.
Milyfa Town -> 米丽法城. Names table lists mainland/Taiwan Chinese names.
Riyado Town -> 利亚多村. Chinese interwiki/nav uses village, not town.
S.S. Cactus -> 仙人掌号. Do not translate school of Pokémon as a school; the ship is the Hoenn wreck.

editorial_rules: Use 宝可梦 and existing Simplified Chinese species/move names consistently.
Interpret bulb as a seed, flower bud, luminous organ, glass globe or actual lamp from the full entry; no blanket noun substitution.
Interpret train as practice or a railway vehicle from its subject and context.
Keep human scientists and Trainers distinct from Pokémon when choosing pronouns.
Preserve the author's numbers, negation, causality, humor and fictional ecology; do not invent official support for custom fusion lore.
Real nuclear fusion remains 核聚变; Pokémon combination remains 融合.
Prefer natural concise Chinese sentences over copied English clause order.
Bark can mean a dog’s noise or literal tree bark. Resolve from the full paragraph.
Spine can mean an exposed defensive thorn, a real backbone or an idiom about fear. Do not convert every instance to 脊椎.
Court in a monarch metaphor means a retinue or royal court, not a law court.
Check which noun a leading modifier belongs to; “long thought extinct” refers to the species, not the paleontologists.
